title: Kucha
subtitle: A Silk Road node of language, music and Buddhist exchange
timeLabel: Sui–Tang transport and Buddhist exchange context
shortSummary: Kucha keeps a pilgrimage route from becoming a straight line from Chang'an to India; it was a region where languages, religions and media intersected.
curatorialDescription: This record uses the real-geography layer for a regional node; specific monasteries, caves, figures and objects require separate records.
Kucha is a historical name whose modern referent and historical extent cannot be reduced to one point.
researchNote: Historical place-name mapping, archaeological reports, cave sites and linguistic-cultural sources still need precise locators.
